semanticReview.method: Seguimiento R33: relectura completa del artículo, reapertura de la revisión anterior, búsquedas distintas en fuentes institucionales/académicas gratuitas e inspección de los pasajes listados. Se conserva pendiente cuando no hay cobertura de todas las afirmaciones materiales.
findings: 私（わたし） is a general first-person form used across formal and daily contexts. Official guidance describes わたし as the standard/general form, but the article’s current spoken-use scope is not fully evidenced.
It is neutral and widely acceptable for all speakers. The official report says わたし is general; CEJC counts show gender and situation variation, so universal neutrality is too broad.
Its frequency/register differences versus 僕, 俺 and わたくし are as stated. CEJC provides counts and scene/style distributions for some forms, not a complete comparative hierarchy.
The sample sentences and omitted-pronoun claims are source-supported. The report supports pronoun avoidance generally, but the article’s examples are editorial and not in the sources.
